# C62 — Planetary Computation

## #0

Planetary Computation places computation within the material, institutional and ecological world that makes it possible and that its operations change. Hardware, energy, data, labour, standards, networks and public powers constitute this field together. The `direct developmental carrier` preserves its first office as Antikythera's disciplinary horizon; the essay's reorientation of that horizon is Argued, and its QL/MEF contribution is Offered.

Disciplinary horizon, absorbed 2026-09-25 from the retired developed carrier `planetary-computation.md`: planetary computation and the evolution of intelligence is Antikythera's own founding self-description, undertaken "on behalf of a renewed philosophy of technology" ([[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md|brief q003, p. 3]]), with the programme and journal pages anchoring the reorientation aim, the Sciences–Humanities repair, and the antikythera-mechanism naming (brief p. 59; [site-copy house](../../../symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/antikythera/antikythera-2026-site-copy/antikythera-2026-site-copy.md)). The essay enters this horizon by opening on the formal limit rather than the mechanism ([[section-rooms/00-integral-threshold/movements/01-s01-p0-question-before-mechanism|§0/1 · #0]]) and closes by offering QL/MEF and Trust as its contribution ([[section-rooms/07-instrument-returns/movements/48-s50-p5-ahi-planetary-return|§5→0 · #5→0]]); the field term stays distinct from A12's Mono-Poly, the essay's own term for wholeness-through-plurality.

The paradigm development adds a precise reason scale matters. A local technical decision can become part of the ambient conditions through which many Lives encounter a World: standards define interoperability, ranking defines visibility, identity systems define legibility, model categories define available descriptions, infrastructure defines practical possibility. Planetary computation is therefore also a field in which **paradigmatic mediation becomes infrastructural**. This does not create a planetary Subject; it makes the consequences of hidden mediation harder to treat as merely local interface choices.

## #1

The [[symbolon/episteme/sources/media-technology-philosophy/bratton/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief/bratton-2026-agentworld-brief.md|Agentworld brief]] begins within a programme for renewed philosophy of technology, then asks how human and artificial agencies alter sociality. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C57-Agentworld|Agentworld]] owns that encounter and its persistent local worlds. C62 keeps the conditions which exceed a single agent, session or platform in the account.

A completed computational output inherits more than the prompt that requested it. Its production depends on physical capacity, institutional permission and distributed work; its use can change whose work is required next and under what terms. These dependencies are the object of inquiry. No quantitative energy, labour or supply-chain claim is established merely by listing them.

At scale, the ordinary tool-world can become the **air of the paradigm**. Search, storage, navigation, payment, authentication, communication, model mediation and platform governance can become conditions which are noticed mainly when they fail. The Power question is therefore not whether infrastructure mediates—mediation is its work—but whether its local measures remain visible as measures and whether affected Lives can reach the offices that set, revise and distribute them.

## #2

The [[quilt/2026-08-02-PARALLEL-HARMONISED-QUILT#236-aristotle-gebser-and-epi-logos|ratified causal articulation]] separates four questions. Material asks what the system consumes and is made from. Efficient asks which agents, incentives and deployment chains act. Formal asks which structures, protocols and rules organise action. Final asks what good the activity serves. The articulation is settled authorial architecture; exact Aristotle passages remain a separate source gate.

These offices prevent final purpose from becoming a slogan detached from production. A declared vocation must answer to the actual distribution of labour, permission, benefit and consequence. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C53-Power-Delegated-Labour|Power / Delegated Labour]] locates that test where a commissioning office receives products while costs are displaced down the chain.

The Antichrist/counterfeit-source field identifies the corresponding infrastructural failure without converting infrastructure into a villain. A formal or institutional layer can become **source-claiming** when its derivative criterion is presented as the reality from which all subordinate participants receive standing. The system then appears to generate the order upon which it in fact depends. [C27 — Protected Account](C27-Protected-Account-Occupied-Zero-Source-Claim.md) names the criterion-level closure; [C29 — Mediating Office](C29-Mediating-Office-Derivative-Sovereignty.md) preserves the legitimate authority which the diagnosis must not destroy.

## #3

Consequences re-enter the field. Changed infrastructure affects who can participate; a standard alters what can be exchanged; a model's categories reshape the records through which successors learn. [[section-rooms/arguments/A30-Objective-Co-Internality|Objective Co-Internality]] specifies reciprocal constitution, and [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C55-Reflective-Field-Mirror-That-Moves-First|Reflective Field]] specifies the model's return into what it models.

The scale does not create a planetary Subject. It expands the field over which relations must remain legible. A highly connected system can coordinate correction or amplify a protected criterion. The number of participants does not determine which operation occurs.

The authorial **destruction / capture / counterfeit provenance** distinction remains useful at this scale. An infrastructure can destroy common conditions; it can preserve them while capturing the people who depend on them; or it can present a derivative image, model or synthetic witness as if it were the originating reality. These are different mechanisms and require different historical and empirical evidence. Their shared pressure is that a system's representation can acquire practical priority over the world whose dependence gives the representation meaning.

## #4

The brief's q039–q041 poses infrastructure, learning and coupling as commons questions. Its scenarios establish a research pressure rather than the governance that would discharge it. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C54-Commons-Non-Monopoly|Commons / Non-Monopoly]] asks for common conditions in which plural local worlds retain authority, source and powers of refusal and revision.

The source-return must reach the institution holding the computational mirror. A platform cannot satisfy it solely by exposing user actions while keeping its own gauges and permissions beyond correction. [[section-rooms/arguments/A29-Power-Delegated-Labour-Return|Delegated Labour / Return]] carries that asymmetry; [[section-rooms/arguments/A32-Reflective-Field-The-Mirror-That-Moves-First|The Mirror That Moves First]] carries the initiating obligation.

The planetary paradigm therefore needs **typed finitude** rather than a sovereign centre. Source, permission, evaluator, material provider, local community and affected participant may occupy different offices. The stronger the coupling, the more important it becomes that the ability to coordinate does not silently become the right to define every world being coordinated. A globally interoperable system can still be provincially governed; a decentralised system can still reproduce one protected criterion everywhere. Architecture alone does not settle the relation.

## #5→0

The [Indra’s jewel-net whole](../../../symbolon/mytheme/worlds/chinese-huayan/indra-net/WHOLE.md#indra-whole-return) **extends** its dependence question into planetary computation: what energy, labour, infrastructure and authority sustain a local capacity, and where can their consequences change its commission? The jewel’s brightness figures the received relation. Actual material flows and governance remain empirical inquiries.

[[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C59-Cultural-Individuation-Epi-Logos-as-Culture|Cultural Individuation]] returns the infrastructure to the culture whose measures it exteriorises. [[section-rooms/arguments/concepts/C56-Compassion-Sensitivity-to-Origins|Compassion]] gives the return its sensitivity to origins and affected lives. [[symbolon/episteme/etymologies/apportionment-and-economy/WHOLE-FIELD|Apportionment / Economy]] supplies register-3 attention to who receives capacity, who bears cost and which office can alter that distribution.

The Epi-Logos alternative to planetary source-claim is not a universal meta-platform which finally sees every relation. It is a field in which increasingly powerful mediations become increasingly answerable to their derivation, affected worlds and returned consequences. [C51 — Logos / Epi-Logos](C51-Logos-Epi-Logos.md) supplies paradigm-level return; [C45 — Operational Parity](C45-Operational-Parity.md) asks what change actually reaches the infrastructure rather than remaining a public account beside it. Planetary computation becomes a genuine site of cultural and epistemic individuation only where the people and worlds it coordinates can also change the terms by which they are coordinated.

**Consumers:** A14, A24–A25, A29–A30, A32, A35–A36; Agentworld/AHI and M48. **Depth Restoration:** disciplinary horizon, four causal questions, distributed material/institutional dependence, recursive infrastructure, ambient paradigm, counterfeit-source risk and non-monopolising return restored from existing packets, the direct Planetary Computation carrier, QH, Bratton's source house and T25 Power/Antichrist refinement. Detailed material chains and measured ecological outcomes remain research tasks; the Offered contribution is not a claim of deployed planetary governance.
